products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a non-profit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital art application. According to its own site, the project is community governed and distributed without cloud dependency, positioning it as a freely available tool for digital painters and artists.

The foundation's tracked AI product, Krita AI, falls within the image and graphic design category. The site describes the AI functionality as delivered through local AI plugins, meaning processing runs on the user's own hardware rather than through external cloud services. This approach reflects the project's broader open-source ethos and community governance model.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are held for the Krita Foundation at this time.
